newsitem.title: BELGIUM: D'IETEREN SELLS MORE AVIS SHARES.
newsitem.headline: D'IETEREN SELLS MORE AVIS SHARES.

text.p: Belgian car distributor D'Ieteren NV said in a statement on Monday the lead managers of the Avis Europe stock offering had exercised their "green shoe" option to purchase a further 30 million shares, or 5.1 percent, in Avis from D'Ieteren.

"As a result, the stake held by D'Ieteren group is reduced to 56.9 percent, with 10.9 percent being held by D'Ieteren SA and 46 percent by its fully owned subsidiary D'Ieteren Invest SA," the company said.
D'Ieteren said the sale raised around 2 billion Belgian francs which it will use to cut its debt.
In addition, the group will book an extraordinary capital gain of around 520 million Belgian francs.
